topic: repair a scratch on a leather sofa
core_question: How do I fix a scratch on a leather couch?
answer_summary: Clean the scratched area, work a color-matched leather repair filler or conditioning cream into the scratch with a soft cloth in circular motions to blend it into the surrounding leather, then buff.
persona: skeptical and testy; texting quickly with typos here and there
